skill_friction: Step 5 lists 'a requirement that contradicts itself' as an ask trigger, but gives no guidance for requirements that look contradictory yet reconcile into a conditional rule ('required, but not for X'); I decided without asking, but the boundary is judgment-heavy.
The AskCoworker table says a split retry 'sends both halves and counts as one retry', but run.json kinds have no way to mark two calls as one split retry; I logged both halves as kind 'retry'.

Rule 3's 'after two wrong AskCoworker claims, verify every AskCoworker fact you keep' triggered mid-run (validation rules 'not queryable', GenAiFunction 'not deployable', FLS needed for system-mode DML, no permission set FLS rows, no PRIORVALUE); the skill does not say whether untestable platform claims already used earlier must be re-examined.

No guidance on planner-local GenAiFunction copies (Create_Promotion_179Kj...) when an invocable signature changes: the content rule says include 'the agent action whose input schema must change' but not whether each per-planner copy is its own row; I made one row and listed the copies in Section 8.

The Access design rule says to name exact permission sets for a new field, but when no editable permission set has Create/Edit on the object, it is unclear whether a Read-only mirror grant is 'needed by a responsibility' or should be an open decision.
The RUNNER note says to use {out}/.tmp for scratch files, but the sandbox denied 'rm -rf'; cleanup needed rm plus rmdir.
